response.explanation: At line 11, src/presentation/app.ts imports createRepositories from src/persistence/repositories.ts. It calls that function once, at line 21, inside buildApp. The resulting repos object is passed to the constructors of the business services (TeamService, PlayerService, RefereeService, FixtureService, PitchService, TableService and WeatherService, lines 22-28). In the code shown, the route handlers only call services and never touch repos directly. So app.ts is acting as the composition root: it wires persistence into business, and there is no visible data access that bypasses the business layer. Even so, the presentation module depends on the persistence module at compile time without going through business. That is the layer skip FF-S03 flags. Line 10 follows the same pattern, importing Gateways and createGateways from ../persistence/gateways, which makes presentation's coupling to persistence wider than this one edge. No documentation, ADR or comment was provided that declares an intent or an exception for this wiring, and the code contains no comment that grants it.
